name: UW VEX U Robotics
description: Designs, builds, and programs robots for the international VEX U Robotics competition, open to students with or without competitive robotics experience.

cycles.notes: The site's join link is a Google Form that says it's no longer in use and redirects to a Microsoft Form titled F24-Sign-Ups-Application, a Fall 2024 posting that references an in-person sign-in booth from that term. Neither is a real current join path. The team is still active, won the Inspire Award at the 2025 VEX U World Championship, so reach out via the site's contact form or uwvexu@gmail.com to ask about joining.
